name: @narduk-enterprises/narduk-ui
description: Narduk shared interface library. Ships the Narduk Status Design System token layer and the instruments component family.

scripts.//lint: vitest.config.ts is linted. It imports @vitejs/plugin-vue, and tracing import-x/no-cycle through vite@7 crashes eslint-plugin-import-x@4.17.1 ("node with invalid interface loaded as resolver"), so the root eslint.config.mjs turns that rule off for it, as for narduk-charts and narduk-shell. The script passes no --ignore-pattern: narduk-lint treats that as a narrowed run that never writes lint-budget.json.
scripts.quality: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit

//devDependencies: happy-dom, @vitejs/plugin-vue, @vue/test-utils, @vue/server-renderer and @types/node are pinned to exact versions already resolved in this workspace's lockfile. A caret range makes pnpm re-resolve the shared entry to the newest satisfying release and re-key or move it for every other package, which is exactly the silent dependency drift narduk-libs#124 warns folds against. Widen them in a deliberate workspace-wide bump, not here.
